description: Northrop 8A-3P (c/n 415) FAP-277 which force-landed at Sacraca on 12 January 1957 and stayed in the village; long kept in its post-crash state on the plaza, it was cosmetically restored by the Lampa district municipality and re-displayed in silver with red cowling and 'FAP 277' titles in a rebuilt plaza (drone video circa 2022, which calls it 'Douglas 277'). One of very few surviving Northrop A-17 family airframes.
museum_name: Northrop 8A-3P FAP 277 Monument, San Sebastián de Sacraca
